svg.text: A finite bridge from spatial motion to diagram moves
Exact coordinate models for Lemma 45.0b and Theorem 45.0.
1. One vertex change uses two empty triangles
Full link: a,u,v,z,b,c,a. Nonincident edge clearance d=1.
‖w−v‖²=⅛ < d²/4. Barycentric sheet distance is at most ‖w−v‖.
Affine 3D view; metric bound uses the displayed exact spatial coordinates.
2. The swept strand may have the middle height
Fixed E: y=x−1, height +1. Fixed F: y=−x+7, height −1.
At t=½, both intersections reach X=(4,3). E > sheet > F.
Each strand keeps its height order. Local arcs continue outside this face.
3. Explicit smooth local lifts of all three moves
(s²,s³−ts,hs). Shown h>0; at t>0, s=±√t have different heights.
At the projected cusp the spatial derivative still has third component h.
At t=0 the plane arcs are tangent; the spatial arcs remain disjoint.
Crossings: (0,0), (−t,0), (0,t). Shown h₁>h₃>h₂; all orders/orientations allowed.
Models shown where cutoff χ=1; endpoint collars stay fixed.
